name: Yokoyama Haruko
source:
"The Mischievous Housewife"

A laid-back, straightforward woman. She’s the kind of person who looks on the bright side of everything. A real optimist and she’s the life of the party.

Her dream for the future is to start a baseball team with her own children.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yoga/chara.html]official site[/url]]
